ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, with (preposition) · 'where' as a place conjunction (ኀበ ትነብር 'where she dwells'; ch. 17–19 headings) · how (in a chapter heading: ኀበ መከረ ንጉሥ 'how the king took counsel'; ኀበ አንገሥዎ 'how they enthroned him') · toward (ኀበ ኵሉ ዘአንጸርከ 'toward all that you face')
ወአውሥአ: አውሥአ — and he answered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሥአ)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
ገበርከ: ገብረ — you have done (2ms perfect, g-b-r)
ለእግዚኣብሔር: እግዚአብሔር — of/to God · God as object, marked with ለ- after ፈርሆ, አምዕዕዎ, አሥመሮ
ወትከውን: ኮነ — and you will be (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, k-w-n; the same letters could be 3fs 'she', see the unit note)
እምነ: እምነ — from (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · from among (እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants'; 'apart from' is also possible there) · than, in comparison (ጥበብ ትኄይስ እምነ ኴሉ 'wisdom is better than all')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word')
እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected')
አማልክተ: አምላክ — gods (noun; plural አማልክት, accusative form)
ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife')
ትከውን: ኮነ — you will be (2ms imperfect) · also 3fs 'she/it becomes, is' (እንተ ትከውን ሲሳየ 'which is food')
ወይፌኑ: ፈነወ — and he would send (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G; habitual 'would send')
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as, up to (preposition) · conjunction 'until' before a subjunctive (እስከ ይትፌጸም 'until might be fulfilled')
በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
በአሐቲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- + fem. numeral አሐቲ)
ወዓልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not, none (ወ- + ዓልቦ, written with ዓ-)
ልብ: ልብ — heart (noun; here the genitive in ሐዘነ ልብ 'sorrow of heart')
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay')
ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — wife (noun; construct 'wife of') · accusative 'a woman, a wife' (አውሰበ አሐተ ብእሲተ 'he married one woman') · ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife'
ቤተ: ቤት — house of (noun, construct) · accusative 'a house' (አተወት ቤተ 'she settled in a house') · ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church' (lit. 'house of Christians')
ውስቴቱ: ውስተ — within it, in it (preposition ውስተ, stem ውስቴ- + 3ms suffix -ቱ)
በቅድሜከ: ቅድም — in your presence, before you (በ- + ቅድሜ- + -ከ '2ms your')
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · concessive 'although' (እንዘ ለሊሁ በኴር 'although he himself was firstborn'; ch. 16) · እንዘ ይብል 'saying' introducing speech (ch. 36)
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ገቢረ: ገብረ — to do, doing (infinitive/verbal noun of ገብረ, accusative)
ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy')
ወድንጉፀ: ድንጉፅ — and stunned, dazed (ወ- + adj., accusative)
ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
ወትኴንን: ኰነነ — and you will rule, judge (ወ- + 2ms imperfect, G, k-ʷ-n-n)
አህጉረ: ሀገር — cities (noun; plural አህጉር, accusative form)
ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
አምላከ: አምላክ — God of (noun, construct) · also accusative 'a god' (ካልአ አምላከ 'another god')
ለዘ: ዘ — (to/of the one) whom (ለ- + relative pronoun; ወቦ ለዘ 'and there is one whom') · to him who (ለእግዚኣብሔር ለዘ ገብረ ኵሎ 'to God, who made all')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he (3m sg independent pronoun) · also demonstrative 'that' before a noun (በውስተ ውእቱ ሥዕለ 'in that image') and copula 'it is' after a predicate (ጽድቅ ውእቱ 'true it is')
ይኤዝዝ: አዘዘ — he commands (3ms imperfect, G, ʾ-z-z; the አ- is a root letter, not a causative prefix)
በጥበቡ: ጥበብ — by his wisdom (በ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
